notes.title: Not dead - just resting.
notes.content:
My obligations with FortressCraft have dragged on much longer than I anticipated, and this has impacted other projects. After The Adventurs Pack DLC for FC is out, I should be finally shipping ADAPTR - not long after that should be a return to the final stretch of Tactics Forever!

So once ADATPR is live, come back here and watch this space!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/516570/ADAPTR/
